description: This Python source file defines functions for adding service-specific attributes to OpenTelemetry spans, including functions for TTS, STT, LLM, Gemini, and OpenAI real-time spans, as well as a helper for extracting standardized system names from service class names.

methods.name: _get_gen_ai_system_from_service_name
methods.description: Extracts a standardized gen_ai.system value from a service class name, using special case mappings or pattern-based lowercasing.

methods.name: add_tts_span_attributes
methods.description: Adds TTS-specific attributes to an OpenTelemetry span, including service name, model, voice ID, text, metrics, settings, and additional keyword arguments.

methods.name: add_stt_span_attributes
methods.description: Adds STT-specific attributes to an OpenTelemetry span, including service name, model, transcript, language, user ID, metrics, settings, and additional keyword arguments.

methods.name: add_llm_span_attributes
methods.description: Adds LLM-specific attributes to an OpenTelemetry span, including service name, model, messages, output, tools, parameters, and additional keyword arguments.

methods.name: add_gemini_live_span_attributes
methods.description: Adds Gemini Live specific attributes to an OpenTelemetry span, including service name, model, transcript, tools, settings, and additional keyword arguments.

methods.name: add_openai_realtime_span_attributes
methods.description: Adds OpenAI Realtime specific attributes to an OpenTelemetry span, including service name, model, transcript, context, function calls, tools, session properties, and additional keyword arguments.
